mapper.select: select MATCH.TMP_C_NAME tmpCName, MATCH.TMP_E_NAME tmpEName, MATCH.DTO_NAME dtoName, MATCH.TMP_COL_E_NAME tmpColEName, MATCH.TMP_COL_C_NAME tmpColCName, MATCH.DTO_COL_E_NAME dtoColEName, MATCH.DTO_COL_C_NAME dtoColCName FROM VAL_INTERF_DTO_MATCH MATCH WHERE MATCH.TMP_E_NAME=#{tmpEName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND MATCH.DTO_NAME=#{dtoName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select PRD.FINPROD_ID finprodId from FIN_PRODUCT PRD LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BOK ON PRD.FINPROD_ID=BOK.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID where PRD.FINPROD_TYPE='F16'

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID, A.FINPROD_TYPE FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT A WHERE A.BRANCH = 0 AND A.BRANCH_TYPE IS NULL
AND A.FINPROD_TYPE != 'F21'
union all SELECT B.FINPROD_ID, B.FINPROD_TYPE FROM FIN_PRODUCT B WHERE B.finprod_type = 'F21'
